new_open.evidence: raw/extra_post.stdout.log INDEPENDENT_POST_PREPARE_CLEANUP and failed zero-replacement-writes assertion; raw/extra_post.exit.log=1

new_open.required_obligation: Anchor/revalidate the original archive parent/root for the adapter actual invocation lifetime, or explicitly refuse unsupported post-prepare protected archival without side effects; root selects authorized implementation.
